data.name: Bolt (Base)
data.description: These +2 bolts scream when fired, forcing all enemies of the wielder within 20 feet of the path of the bolt to succeed on a DC 14 Will save or become shaken. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

source.original_ingest_defect: same-line 'DESC:.CLEAR' sentinel followed by a real DESC: token on the same corpus row; an earlier codegen pass captured only the .CLEAR sentinel (SD-25 criterion 7.N fix)
